newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks rebound on bottom-fishers.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks rebound on bottom-fishers.

text.p: Mexican stocks returned to positive turf in the final hour of trade on Thursday as bottom-fishers stepped into the market, traders said.
"It was obvious that buyers would be wooed back to the market after profits had been taken. We also saw some foreign day-trippers," a trader said.
The leading IPC share index was up 15.63 points, or 0.44 percent, at 3573.60.
"I don't think inflation data are affecting the market, because they're already discounted -- unless they're much below expectations," the trader added.
